claim: Try it with sample data opens a playable dodge game in the first screen.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:sample-demo
sandbox: fresh context at /?demo=1; assert heading, canvas, Start round, and touch pad intersect the initial viewport; start and reset the round

claim: Demo data is disposable and separate from every real project and license value.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-isolation
sandbox: pre-seed a real IndexedDB project and license keys; mutate and exit demo; deep-compare all real values and assert no verification request

claim: Drawing, photo cleanup, and play need no account and upload no artwork.
where: landing facts, drawing controls, privacy page, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-private
sandbox: intercept the complete demo drawing, local photo-cleanup, and play flow; assert every request is same-origin

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: make staticwebapp.config.json return the production 404; activate the worker; go offline; reload /demo and start the game

claim: Game settings are saved in this browser.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:saved-browser
sandbox: change demo speed, reload, and confirm the selected setting

claim: Turn two drawings into a tiny game.
where: landing H1, game maker heading, README, catalog
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:drawing-game
sandbox: enter through /demo, start for real, draw and save two new inputs, play, and verify both saved sprite images

claim: Choose dodge, collect, or maze for the same two drawings.
where: game chooser, How it works, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:three-games
sandbox: from fresh demo data, observe the dodge timer, collect a drawing, and solve the fixed maze in 21 moves

claim: Use a clear photo on plain paper and remove its light background.
where: How it works, drawing controls, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:photo-cleanup
sandbox: load the paper-drawing fixture in /demo, remove paper, and assert transparency increases while dark drawing pixels remain

claim: Export a game as a project file.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:project-export
sandbox: download the seeded demo project and confirm its filename and readable stream

claim: Import a game from a project file.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:project-import
sandbox: load a valid project file into /demo and confirm its maze rule

claim: Use arrow keys, W, A, S, and D keys, or the touch pad.
where: How it works, play screen, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:controls
sandbox: start /demo and exercise an arrow key, D key, and on-screen direction control

claim: Drawing, saving, playing, and exports are free.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:free-maker
sandbox: leave demo with no license, draw, save, play, and download a project while only four free inks are present

claim: Workshop Pack costs US $9 once and adds four ink colours plus a finish celebration.
where: landing facts, Workshop Pack section, terms, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:workshop-pack
sandbox: use the disposable paid demo preview; count eight total inks, solve the maze, and observe all celebration pieces

claim: Sociobot/Dodo hosts checkout as merchant of record.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:hosted-checkout
sandbox: make one read-only request to the public checkout; assert the Sociobot 303 and named Dodo-hosted product page
